report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts, and an INFO 200 request log. The only anomaly is one ERROR span on gateway->inventory (955ms). This single span is insufficient to establish a bounded root cause, and healthy gateway metrics contradict the alert premise. Handing off for broader telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway metrics show error_rate 0.0012 and p95 70ms, contradicting the alert; need metrics confirming elevated error rate/latency in the alert window.
Need inventory service telemetry (latency, errors, redis timeouts) to assess the ERROR span on gateway->inventory.
Need order and payment service metrics/logs to localize where checkout latency originates.
Need trace volume and error distribution across services, not a single span, to establish scope.
Need redis dependency health metrics to evaluate redis-timeout alternative.
